paragraphs.text: I don't see any way for us to get Largest Army. I wonder whether any Monopoly cards are still out there.
I think our path to winning is to build a city this turn, provided our eights are open.
Orange is out of settlement pieces, so I have a little more freedom to build some roads. Maybe three roads would be reasonable. I don't believe Red.

paragraphs.text: I don't think Orange can get Largest Army; it doesn't seem possible. We're in a good spot to build roads, but there's no way we can actually take Longest Road—the road requirement is absurd.
